meta.title: Husvan
meta.description: Understand what a house costs over time.

home.title: What does the house cost over time?
home.lead: Husvan is the house’s memory. Your own AI reads the listing and the inspection, Husvan keeps what is known about the house and works out maintenance, running costs and replacements, so you can compare the houses on equal terms.
home.split: The thinking in your AI, the memory in Husvan
home.splitLead: AI models keep getting better. Husvan gets better with them, because what takes judgement is done by your AI and what has to last is kept by Husvan.

upload.text: Here are the listing and the inspection report for Videvägen 7 in Boden.

draft.text: I have read both. The house is from 1978 and has a ground source heat pump from 2012. The inspection notes damp in the crawl space and wants it dealt with within 1–3 years. The listing does not mention the roof, but the inspection says concrete tiles from when the house was built. I have entered 16 parts as a draft. Do you want to go through it?
draft.note: draft with 16 parts, every value sourced to a document and passage

approve.text: The heat pump was replaced in 2019, not 2012. Otherwise it looks right.

approved.text: I have changed the heat pump to 2019 with you as the source and approved the draft.
approved.note: draft approved, 2012 kept as an alternative from the listing

cost.text: What will the house cost per year over the next 15 years?

forecast.text: Around 74,000 kronor a year in today’s money, with a range from 58,000 to 96,000. Most of it is running costs. The largest single item is the roof, which is nearing the end of its lifespan. The range is wide because the age of the ventilation is missing. Is it in the energy certificate?
forecast.note: forecast by fixed rules, with a list of what is missing

compare.text: How does it compare with the house on Lingonstigen?

comparison.text: Lingonstigen costs 400,000 kronor more, but has a new roof and newer pipes. Counting the maintenance debt, Videvägen comes out 120,000 kronor more expensive. The difference is almost entirely the roof and the crawl space, so those are what I would ask the agent about.
comparison.note: maintenance-adjusted price for both houses, item by item

connect.title: Connect Husvan to Claude
connect.body: Husvan is a connector in your own Claude. All reading and interpreting happens there.

upload.title: Upload the documents in the chat
upload.body: Listing, inspection report and energy certificate. Claude reads them and proposes parts, values and work items with their source.

approve.title: Approve what Claude read
approve.body: Nothing counts until you approve the draft. On the web you see the same data and correct what came out wrong.

compare.title: Ask and compare
compare.body: Ask Claude about cost per year, maintenance debt and maintenance-adjusted price. The answers build on Husvan’s figures, with a range from low to high.

debt.title: Maintenance debt
debt.body: How much of each part is already used up, in kronor. A roof halfway through its lifespan is half a roof, whenever it is replaced.

adjusted.title: Maintenance-adjusted price
adjusted.body: The price plus the maintenance debt. Two houses at the same price cost differently if one has a new roof and the other old pipes.

forecast.title: Cost per year
forecast.body: Replacements by lifespan, repainting, work items from the inspection and running costs, in today’s kronor over the horizon you choose.

principle.unknown: Unknown is not no. A listing that does not mention a pool does not make it a no.
principle.disclosure: Saying less does not make a house cheaper. Parts every house has are counted even when the documents leave them out.
principle.sources: Every value has a source: which document, which passage and how sure the reading is.
principle.model: The server interprets no documents and calls no AI. Nothing in Husvan is built for a particular model, so a better AI gives better answers without anything being rebuilt.

home.later: Once the house is bought: maintenance plan and year wheel
home.laterBody: The same house becomes the starting point for maintenance, with nothing moved and nothing for you to type in. Every part gets its checks by type, condition and location, and the year wheel lays them out month by month together with the inspection's remarks and the forecast's renewals. Even as a candidate you see the first year's checks and how many need a professional.

wheel.label: Year wheel {year} · Videvägen 7, Boden

items.snow: Keep an eye on snow on the roof
items.bathroom: Joints and floor drain in the bathroom
items.meltwater: Lead meltwater away from the foundation
items.crawlSpace: Damp check in the crawl space
items.facade: Look over the facade and window putty
items.crawlSpaceFix: Fix the damp in the crawl space
items.roof: New roof, the concrete tiles are from 1978
items.heatPump: Service the ground source heat pump

wheel.question: Open question: is there a fireplace? A yes adds chimney sweeping and fire safety inspection, a no removes the question.

check.label: Check
check.title: Damp check in the crawl space
check.why: The inspection remarked on damp in the crawl space. That is why it is every six months instead of once a year, until the work is done.

items.moisture: Moisture content in the sill plate. Above 17% is a remark.
items.smell: A smell of mould or earth when the hatch is opened.
items.stains: White stains, discoloured wood or water on the plastic sheeting.

check.result: A remark becomes a work item and lowers the part's condition, so the forecast is recalculated.
check.notInspection: A self-check does not replace an inspection.

due.text: Good morning. The damp check in the crawl space is due in May, and in November the sill plate was at 15% at the north corner. It takes half an hour. Would you like to plan it in? Saturday morning is free in your calendar.
due.note: today's and this month's items from the year wheel, with the latest log

planned.text: Booked for Saturday at 10, with what to look for. Bring the moisture meter and send a photo of it when you are done, and I will log it.
planned.note: item planned for Saturday; the calendar is your own connector in Claude

log.text: 19% at the north corner, 14% at the other two.

remark.text: That is above the 17% limit. The draft holds a remark, a work item to investigate the north corner and condition 2 instead of 3 for the crawl space. Once you approve it, the forecast is recalculated.
remark.note: the log as a draft with reading, work item and new condition

local.title: By your location
local.body: Checks name a season, not a month. Snowmelt comes in April–May in Boden and in March in Malmö, and the wheel follows.

calendar.title: Your Claude keeps track
calendar.body: A scheduled task in Claude goes through the wheel every morning, tells you when something is due today or this month and asks whether you want to plan it in. If you prefer your calendar, you can subscribe to the wheel.

history.title: The log becomes the house's history
history.body: When selling, it backs up the disclosure questionnaire, and in an insurance claim it shows the house has been maintained.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you an email with a link and a code that sign you in.
login.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
login.useLink: Sign in with a link instead
login.linkSent: If the address may sign in, an email with a link and a code is on its way. Open the link in this browser, or type the code here. Both are valid for ten minutes.
login.codeFailed: The code is wrong or has expired. After three wrong attempts you need a new email.
login.linkFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again.
login.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

consent.title: Grant access
consent.intro: {client} wants to access Husvan on your behalf.
consent.invalid: The approval link is invalid or has expired. Start over from the app that asked for access.
consent.failed: Your answer could not be saved. Try again.

admin.title: Users
admin.intro: Addresses that may sign in. A new address gets its own account the first time it follows a sign-in link. Removing an address signs that user out and ends Claude's access; the houses stay.
admin.addFailed: The address could not be added.
admin.removeFailed: The address could not be removed.
admin.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.

houses.title: Your houses
houses.empty: No houses yet. Add a house by uploading the listing in Claude.
houses.filterHint: Houses without what you picked are hidden. Houses where it is unknown are shown apart, because unknown is not no.
houses.unknownGroup: Not known whether they have what you picked
houses.hiddenCount: {count, plural, one {# house lacks} other {# houses lack}} what you picked and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not shown.
houses.drafts: {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} waiting

houseDetail.draftWaiting: A draft is waiting for your approval: {components} components, {observations} values and {workItems} actions.
houseDetail.previewing: You are looking at the draft with {components} components, {observations} values and {workItems} actions, marked as draft. None of it counts until you approve it.
houseDetail.previewingEdit: You can leave single rows out of the draft and correct values before you approve the rest.
houseDetail.removeComponentBody: The component is set aside with its values, subcomponents and actions and is not approved with the draft. The rest of the draft is not affected.

houseDetail.decisionFailed: The decision could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.

cost.title: Cost
cost.debtHelp: The used-up share of every part, plus the work items. Independent of the horizon, so a roof due in 20 years still counts.
cost.perMonthHelp: Mean over {years} years from {start}, running costs included.
cost.perMonthHelpNoRunning: Mean over {years} years from {start}. Running costs are unknown and not included.
cost.ratioHelp: Price divided by the assessed value, assessment year {year}.
cost.chartNote: Each scenario has its own replacement years, so in a single year low or high can fall on either side of typical. The totals are ordered.
cost.assumedHelp: The documents do not mention the part, but every house has one. It is counted from the construction year.
cost.renewedAs: Renewed more cheaply in low and typical
cost.gapsTitle: What the total leaves out or guesses

gap.notInspected: No inspection protocol: defects are unknown, not none.
gap.workItemsWithoutCost: {count, plural, one {# work item} other {# work items}} without a cost count as zero.
gap.assumedParts: Assumed parts the documents do not mention: {parts}.
gap.partsWithoutInstallationYear: {count, plural, one {# part has} other {# parts have}} the construction year as installation year.
gap.partsWithoutCost: {count, plural, one {# part has} other {# parts have}} no cost.
gap.runningUnknown: Running costs are unknown and not included.

cost.notModelled: Not included yet: snow removal and roof snow clearing, and scaffolding for facade repainting.
cost.indexYear: Amounts in {year} prices, indexed by the construction cost index.
cost.loadFailed: The forecast could not be calculated.

questions.intro: Answer what you can at the viewing. Each answer counts at once. The amount is how much the answer can change the estimate; largest first.
questions.notInspected: The house has no inspection protocol, so its defects are unknown. No question here replaces an inspection.
questions.lookHelp: What you can see yourself as you walk through the house.
questions.askHelp: What the agent or seller usually knows: years, measurements and costs.

status.uncertain: The documents say {value}, but it is uncertain.
status.estimated: Estimated; the actual cost is missing.
status.counted: The number is estimated from the living area.
status.noCost: The cost is missing and counts as zero.
status.conditionAssumed: Unknown. The estimate assumes normal wear.
status.installedAssumed: Unknown. The estimate assumes it is from {year}.
status.paintedAssumed: Unknown. The estimate assumes it was painted in {year}.
status.notDocumented: The documents do not mention the part; your answer adds it.

electrical_panel.rcd: Look in the fuse box for a switch with a test button, often marked T.
electrical_panel.panel_type: Screw-in fuses or circuit breakers with switches?

electrical_installation.wiring: Grounded sockets have earth clips. Cloth-covered cords and ungrounded sockets in dry rooms suggest older wiring.

foundation.foundation_type: Basement, crawl space with a hatch, slab on the ground or plinths?

hint.quantity: Count them as you walk through.

questions.impactDebt: The answer can change the maintenance debt by up to {sek}.
questions.impactForecast: The cost over the next {years} years can change by up to {sek}.
questions.failed: The answer could not be saved.
questions.loadFailed: The questions could not be worked out.
questions.undoFailed: The answer could not be undone.
questions.undoDependedOn: A later answer builds on this one. Undo that first.

flag.assumed_part: Not in the documents; assumed, as every house has one
flag.construction_year_used: Installation year missing; the construction year is used
flag.installation_year_unknown: Installation year unknown; the range covers the whole lifespan
flag.quantity_estimated_shared: {key} estimated from the living area and shared among {count} parts
flag.profile_without_cost: The lifespan profile has no cost
flag.last_painted_missing: Last painted missing; the installation year is used
flag.overdue_replacement: Past its lifespan and flagged as serious by the inspection; replaced in the start year
flag.cheaper_renewal: Low and typical renew it more cheaply ({match}); high replaces it
flag.repaint_overdue: Repainting overdue; put in the start year
flag.inspection_added: Added by Husvan for {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} without an inspection year; it decides whether and how they are renewed
flag.work_item_no_year: No year or severity; put in the start year
flag.no_tariff_changes: No tariff changes for the municipality; no trend
flag.interest_without_loan: Interest without a loan; no capital cost
flag.not_inspected: No inspection protocol: defects are unknown, not none
flag.operating_cost_less_parts: The listing’s operating cost less the parts it names
flag.heating_no_pellet_price: Heating unknown: no price for pellets
flag.heating_no_energy_price: Heating unknown: no energy price for the municipality
flag.heating_estimated: Estimated from primary energy × living area × Fgeo {fgeo} / {weight}: about {kwh} kWh
flag.heating_unknown: Heating unknown: no cost, energy use or energy class
flag.overdue_seen_ok: Past its lifespan, but the inspection saw it without a serious finding; given part of a lifespan more
flag.overdue_unjudged: Past its lifespan and not judged by an inspection; replaced within the coming years, in high at once
flag.work_item_timed_by_severity: No year; spread over {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} by its severity ({severity})
flag.quantity_from_footprint: {key} estimated from the living area over {floors} floors
flag.quantity_from_footprint_shared: {key} estimated from the living area over {floors} floors and shared among {count} parts
flag.one_of_several: The house has {count} of these; while another one works, this one is less urgent
flag.scenarios_cross: Low, typical and high are whole paths with their own replacement years, and a replacement resets the repainting, so this item’s range is not ordered; the house totals are
flag.ground_rent_revised: The ground rent is revised in {year}; the same amount is kept after that but is uncertain
flag.ground_rent_no_revision_year: Revision year missing; the rent may be revised within the horizon, so it is uncertain throughout

risk.private_sewage: Private sewage system that must be renewed

key.share_post_secondary_3y_plus: Share with 3+ years of post-secondary education

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.unchangedNote: Empty fields are left as they are. A new assumption takes the place of the old one; nothing is overwritten.

compare.title: Compare houses
compare.pick: Pick 2–6 houses in the list to compare them.
compare.sorted: Sorted by maintenance-adjusted price, lowest first.
compare.largestNote: Typical scenario, total over the horizon. Unknown is not zero: an empty cell means the documents say nothing, and a note under a figure says what it rests on.
compare.findingsNote: A house without an inspection protocol has unknown defects, not none. A finding in one house may well apply to an uninspected one too, and its lower figure may come from knowing less.
compare.runningUnknownNote: Running costs are unknown for {addresses}, so the forecast is lower for that reason alone.

basis.assumed: Assumed part, not in the documents
basis.estimated: Estimated from the primary energy number

edit.title: Change {key}
edit.userWins: Your value is saved as a new entry and wins over Claude’s. The old one stays as an alternative.
edit.draftUserWins: Your value takes the draft value’s place in the draft and is approved with the rest. The draft value is set aside.
edit.removeValueFromDraftTitle: Leave the value out of the draft?
edit.removeValueFromDraftBody: The value is set aside and is not approved with the draft. The rest of the draft is not affected.
edit.retractBody: The value is kept but no longer counts. If there is another value for the same key, that one is used instead.

workItemEdit.restateNote: The change is saved as a new work item that replaces the old one, so it is not counted twice.
workItemEdit.dismissBody: The work item is kept but no longer counts in the forecast or the maintenance debt.
workItemEdit.removeFromDraftLabel: Leave the work item {description} out of the draft
workItemEdit.removeFromDraftTitle: Leave the work item out of the draft?
workItemEdit.removeFromDraftBody: The work item is set aside and is not approved with the draft. The rest of the draft is not affected.

core.title: Change the house
core.statusHelp: Your decision about the house. The state of the sale is a value of its own.
core.duplicate: Another house has the same address or property designation: {address}

upload.hint: PDF, image or text, at most 25 MB. If Claude has already saved the document, the file is attached to it. The server does not read the file; ask Claude to interpret it in the chat.

done.sha256: The file was attached to the document Claude saved.
done.document: The file was attached to the document.

error.type: That file type is not accepted. Upload a PDF, an image or a text file.
error.too_large: The file is larger than 25 MB.
error.other_house: The same file already belongs to another house.
error.hash_mismatch: This is not the file Claude saved for the document.
error.already_uploaded: The document already has a file.
error.storage: File storage is not set up.
error.generic: The file could not be uploaded.

annual.title: Cost per year, spread over the lifespan
annual.renewedAs: Renewed more cheaply in low and typical: {how}
annual.note: Each replacement and repaint is divided by the years it lasts, so a bathroom for 200,000 kr that lasts 25 years is 8,000 kr a year whenever it is paid. Work items from the inspection are left out: they are overdue maintenance and count in the maintenance debt.
